title: Ceasefire Surge: Risk Assets Rebound
content: A US-Iran two-week ceasefire sends oil prices tumbling below $100 per barrel, igniting a Bitcoin rally back to $72,000. Risk appetite returns as geopolitical tensions ease temporarily. Ethereum stablecoin supply hits an all-time high of $180 billion, signaling strong on-chain demand. Morgan Stanley launches the lowest-fee Bitcoin ETF at 0.14%, while ARK Invest adds $13 million to Robinhood amid Treasury's Trump Accounts initiative. Polymarket traders cashed in big on low-odds ceasefire bets. Iran's Bitcoin hashrate drops 77% due to conflict, but the network remains resilient. UBS and Swiss banks test franc stablecoins; quantum cryptography debates heat up for Ethereum. SEC acknowledges some crypto cases yielded no investor benefits. Despite bearish warnings of a potential $15K BTC shakeout, long-term holders absorb supply. Stay disciplined – markets reward patience over panic.
mantra: Peace prints green candles; wisdom stacks through storms.
